name: Kern Technology
summary: Adelaide dialup + hosting + e-commerce ISP (BankSA eCommerce partner, ISO 9002); defunct (KERN TECHNOLOGY PTY LTD, ACN 060 754 476).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of own domain (by 1998).
Acquired by Adam Internet. kern.com.au had become an Adam Internet page by Feb 2012 and redirected to adam.com.au/residential.

refs.label: Kern was still a standalone Adelaide ISP in Jan 2010.
By Feb 2012 kern.com.au serves Adam Internet branding.
From 2013 the domain redirects to Adam Internet's residential page.
